description_en: Set a message to read status
description_zh: 将某一条留言设置为已读状态
name: ReadMessage

fields.help_en: Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the User Identifier in Maojing, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type: PACKAGENAME for the APK package name used in Android client application links, and SKILLID for the skill ID used in cloud-based links
fields.help_zh: 编码类型，获取猫精的用户标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型 - PACKAGENAME：apk包名，Android应用客户链路的编码类型 - SKILLID：技能ID，云端链路的编码类型
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en: Value corresponding to the encoding type. When the encoding type is SKILLID, this value is the Skill ID of the application. When the encoding type is PACKAGENAME, this value is the packageName of the corresponding client app
fields.help_zh: 编码类型对应的值，编码类型是SKILLID时，其值为应用的Skill ID； 编码类型是PACKAGENAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en: Type of User ID: OPENID is the default User ID identity. UNIONID is the organization-dimension User ID identity, which is available only after an organization has been registered on the Maojing Skill Application Open Platform
fields.help_zh: 用户Id的类型 - OPENID：默认的用户ID标识 - UNIONID: 组织维度的用户ID标识，在猫精技能应用开放平台申请过组织后才会有
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en: Organization ID. Required when IdType is UNION_ID
fields.name: organization_id

Code.description_en: Status code returned by the service. Only "SUCCESS" indicates success; all other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 服务返回的状态码，只有SUCCESS为成功，否则均为失败
